nodes.Name: Func
nodes.DocComment: A Func represents a single assembly function.

Fields.Name: inputs
Fields.DocComment: name of input slices (not beginning with z)

Fields.Name: outputs
Fields.DocComment: names of output slices (beginning with z)

Fields.Name: args
Fields.DocComment: offsets of args, results on stack

nodes.Name: Func
nodes.DocComment: Func starts a new function in the assembly output.

nodes.Name: Arg
nodes.DocComment:
Arg allocates a new register, copies the named argument (or result) into it,
and returns that register.

nodes.Name: ArgHint
nodes.DocComment: ArgHint is like Arg but uses a register allocation hint.

nodes.Name: ArgPtr
nodes.DocComment: ArgPtr is like Arg but returns a RegPtr.

nodes.Name: StoreArg
nodes.DocComment: StoreArg stores src into the named argument (or result).
